name: sellers_per_template
source_sql: SELECT product_tmpl_id AS "productTmplId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_supplierinfo GROUP BY product_tmpl_id ORDER BY product_tmpl_id

name: sellers_per_vendor_currency
source_sql: SELECT partner_id AS "partnerId", currency_id AS "currencyId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_supplierinfo GROUP BY partner_id, currency_id ORDER BY partner_id, currency_id

name: search_product_by_vendor_code
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", partner_id AS "partnerId", product_tmpl_id AS "productTmplId", product_id AS "productId", product_code AS "productCode", product_name AS "productName" FROM product_supplierinfo WHERE product_code IS NOT NULL OR product_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

name: select_seller_order
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", product_tmpl_id AS "productTmplId", partner_id AS "partnerId" FROM product_supplierinfo ORDER BY sequence, min_qty DESC, price, id

name: windowed_discounted_variant_sellers
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", product_id AS "productId", partner_id AS "partnerId" FROM product_supplierinfo WHERE date_start IS NOT NULL AND date_end IS NOT NULL AND discount > 0 AND product_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
